mapper.sql: v.venue_id AS venueId, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.city_name AS cityName, v.address AS address, v.longitude AS longitude, v.latitude AS latitude, IFNULL(s_stat.session_count, 0) AS sessionCount, v.create_time AS createTime, v.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT v.city_name FROM venue v WHERE = GROUP BY v.city_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, v.city_name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.city_name FROM venue v WHERE TRIM(#{stationName}) LIKE CONCAT( TRIM(TRAILING '市' FROM TRIM(v.city_name)), '%' ) GROUP BY v.city_name ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(TRAILING '市' FROM TRIM(v.city_name))) DESC, v.city_name ASC LIMIT 1

FROM venue v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT venue_id, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM performance_session GROUP BY venue_id ) s_stat ON s_stat.venue_id = v.venue_id WHERE = ORDER BY v.venue_name ASC, v.venue_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM venue v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT venue_id, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM performance_session GROUP BY venue_id ) s_stat ON s_stat.venue_id = v.venue_id WHERE v.venue_id = #{venueId} LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO venue ( venue_name, city_name, address, longitude, latitude, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{venueName}, #{cityName}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE venue SET venue_name = #{venueName}, city_name = #{cityName}, address = #{address}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, update_time = NOW() WHERE venue_id = #{venueId}
